video_summary.overall_goal: Add a new medication entry to the app with details including product name, display name, release form, expiration date, package opened date, dose, and comment
video_summary.description: The user opens the medicine list in HomeMedKit app, taps the add button, and fills in a form to create a new medication entry with the name 'medA', release form 'medB', and a comment 'abc'.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The app shows a list of medications with three items visible (dasd, ert, Jbn nb). At the top is a search bar with filter/sort buttons. Bottom navigation has three tabs: Medicine, Intake, Settings.
A floating menu has appeared with two buttons: 'Scan' and 'Add'. The add button is highlighted and ready to tap.
steps.system_response: Form opens for entering medication details
steps.navigation_change: Transition to Add Medication form screen with header bar
steps.visual_feedback: Add button interaction feedback, form appears

steps.what_screen_is_visible: A form with multiple input fields: Product name (showing cursor), Group dropdown, Exp. date, Package opened date, Display name, Release form, Dose, Amount, Usage indications, and Comment fields. Header has back arrow and checkmark.
steps.system_response: Text 'medA' is entered into the field
steps.visual_feedback: Text appears in the Product name field

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Form shows Product name 'medA' is entered. Group field is now focused (green border). Other fields: Exp. date shows date placeholder, Package opened shows date placeholder.
steps.visual_feedback: Green border around Group field indicates focus
steps.intent_task: Select or interact with Group field

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Form continues with Group field filled with 'Empty', Exp. date field now focused and populated with 'May 31, 2026', Package opened field shows 'May 22, 2026'.
steps.system_response: Date value 'May 31, 2026' is set in the field
steps.visual_feedback: Date text appears in Exp. date field

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Form shows: Product name 'medA', Group 'Empty', Exp. date 'May 31, 2026', Package opened field now focused with 'May 22, 2026', Display name field showing 'Empty' (being edited), Release form field visible.
steps.visual_feedback: Date appears in Package opened field

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Form shows all previous fields filled. Display name field is focused (green border) and shows 'medA' being entered. Release form field is visible below.
steps.system_response: Text 'medA' is entered into Display name
steps.visual_feedback: Text 'medA' appears in Display name field
steps.intent_task: Enter the display name for the medication

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Display name field shows 'medA'. Release form field is now focused (green border) with text 'medB'. Below are Dose, Amount, Usage indications, and Comment fields.
steps.system_response: Text 'medB' is entered into Release form field
steps.visual_feedback: Text 'medB' appears in Release form field

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Form shows Release form field with cursor after 'medB'. Comment field at the bottom is now focused (green border) with text 'abc' entered. All other fields remain filled with their values.
steps.system_response: Text 'abc' is entered into Comment field
steps.visual_feedback: Text 'abc' appears in Comment field with cursor
steps.intent_task: Enter a comment for the medication

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Form submission completed. Screen now shows the medication details in view mode: Product name 'medA', Group 'Unspecified', Exp. date 'May 31, 2026', Package opened 'May 22, 2026', Status shows 'Added manually' in red text. Display name section shows 'medA', Release form shows 'medB', Comment shows 'abc'.
steps.system_response: Form is submitted and the view transitions to the detail/confirmation view
steps.navigation_change: Form submission complete, transition to detail view
steps.visual_feedback: Form closes, detail view shows the saved medication with confirmation
steps.intent_task: Submit the medication form and confirm the entry was saved

overall_flow: Tap add button to open add dialog
Tap add option to open form
View confirmation and saved medication details
human_readable_step_summary: Step 1: The app shows a medicine list with existing entries. The user taps the green add button to open the add medication menu.
Step 2: A menu appears with 'Scan' and 'Add' options. The user taps the 'Add' button to open the form.
Step 3: The medication entry form opens with multiple input fields. The user enters 'medA' in the Product name field.
Step 4: The user interacts with the Group field to select or confirm the group.
Step 5: The user enters the expiration date 'May 31, 2026' in the Exp. date field.
Step 6: The user enters the package opened date 'May 22, 2026' in the Package opened field.
Step 7: The user enters 'medA' in the Display name field.
Step 8: The user enters 'medB' in the Release form field.
Step 9: The user enters 'abc' in the Comment field.
Step 10: The user taps the checkmark button to submit the form, and the app displays the saved medication details with 'Added manually' status.
